notes: A053029_conj: for m >= 3, zeros m = 4 (zeros per Pisano period, pisano = least period of fib mod m) iff m odd with all prime factors p having zeros p = 4, or m = 2k with k such. The prime-factor reading fails vacuously at m = 1, 2 (zeros 1 = zeros 2 = 1, Lean zeros_one/zeros_two). Route: zeros = order of u = F_{alpha+1} mod m; u^2 = (-1)^alpha (Cassini); 4 zeros iff alpha odd; alpha(4) = 6; lifting p^j | F_N -> p^{j+1} | F_{pN}; induction over coprime prime powers. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (agreement with data terms by certificate/check.py, m <= 3000).
